{{Quote|True, the Emperor prefers to fill out his ranks with human officers... but some of you humans tend to get rather squeamish about torture. Whereas I'll do anything to get the information I desire. And, just between you and me&mdash;I'll enjoy it.|Unidentified Pau'an to Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="hostage" />}}
This '''male Pau'an''' served as an interrogator for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sometime around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. When [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was captured by the Empire on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]], the Pau'an was tasked to interrogate Organa to learn the identity of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|pilot]] who destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. Before he could begin though, the Imperial base sounded its alarms due to intruders. Leaving Organa strapped to a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] slab, the Pau'an went out of the interrogation room to investigate when he was shot in the head by the Imperial [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]], who was working undercover with the Rebels to also learn the identity of the Death Star's destroyer.<ref name="hostage" />
